sys alert lcd(1)					BIG-IP TMSH Manual					  sys alert lcd(1)

NAME
       alert - Manages outstanding alerts.

MODULE
       sys

SYNTAX
       Manages the outstanding alerts on the system when used with the syntax below.

   DISPLAY
	show alert lcd

   MODIFY
	reset-stats alert lcd
	reset-stats alert lcd [ priority { alert | critical | emergency | error | info | warning } ]

DESCRIPTION
       You can use the lcd component to display or clear the lcd alerts for the system.  The clear lcd alerts can be issued with
       the priority option followed by the priority value in which case only alerts with matching priority are cleared.

EXAMPLES
       show alert lcd

       Displays lcd alerts.

       reset-stats alert lcd

       Clears all lcd alerts.

SEE ALSO
       reset-stats, show, sys alert lcd, tmsh
